# Bartib

Bartib is an easy to use time tracking tool for the command line. It saves a log of all tracked activities as a plaintext file and allows you to create flexible reports.

Usage examples

Start a new activity:

  bartib start -d "Description of the activity" -p "Project Name"

Stop the running activity:

  bartib stop

Continue the most recent activity:

  bartib continue

List today's activities:

  bartib list --today

Report for today:

  bartib report --today

Configuration

Bartib records activities in a plaintext log file. You can either pass the file explicitly with the -f/--file option, or set the BARTIB_FILE environment variable to point to your log file. Example:

  export BARTIB_FILE="/home/username/activities.bartib"

If the file does not exist, Bartib will create it when you start tracking.

Installation

Download a prebuilt executable from the project's releases and place it in a directory on your PATH (for example: ~/bin). Bartib may also be available through your distribution's package manager.

Autocompletion

Completion scripts for shells may be provided in the repository's misc/ directory. Source the appropriate script for your shell to enable completion of project and task names.

License

This project is provided under the terms of the LICENSE file in this repository.


--- bash completion ---
#!/bin/bash

_bartib_completions()
{
	local CWORD=${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}
	ALL_PROJECTS=`bartib projects`

	local IFS=$'\n'
	CANDIATE_PROJECTS=($(compgen -W "${ALL_PROJECTS[*]}" -- "$CWORD"))

	if [ ${#CANDIATE_PROJECTS[*]} -eq 0 ]; then
		COMPREPLY=()
	else
		COMPREPLY=($(printf "\"%s\"\n" "${CANDIATE_PROJECTS[@]}"))
	fi
}

complete -F _bartib_completions bartib

    _values "TASK" ${_tasks[@]}

_bartib_projects() {
    local -a _projects=($(bartib projects --no-quotes | sort | tr '\n' ' '))

        self.assertEqual(self.log.read_text(), f'{today} 09:00 | Work | Read \\| write\\\\test\n')
        result = self.run_cli('stop', '-t', '10:15')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, f'Stopped activity: "Read | write\\test" (Work) started at {today} 09:00 (1h 15m)\n')
        self.run_cli('continue', '-t', '10:30')
        result = self.run_cli('change', '-d', 'New task', '-p', 'Home', '-t', '10:45')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, f'Changed activity: "New task" (Home) started at {today} 10:45\n')
        result = self.run_cli('cancel')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, f'Canceled activity: "New task" (Home) started at {today} 10:45\n')

        self.assertEqual(self.log.read_text().count(' - '), 2)

        expected = ('\n\x1b[1mAlpha..... 1h 15m\x1b[0m\n    First. 1h 15m\n'
                    '\n\x1b[1mBeta...... 1h 30m\x1b[0m\n    Second 1h 30m\n'
                    '\n\x1b[1mTotal..... 2h 45m\x1b[0m\n\n')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, expected)
        self.assertEqual(plain(self.run_cli('report', '-p', 'Alpha').stdout),
                         '\nAlpha.... 1h 15m\n    First 1h 15m\n\nTotal.... 1h 15m\n\n')

        self.assertIn('\x1b[1m2024-01-01\t1h 00m\x1b[0m', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('09:00\u00a0\u00a0 10:00', result.stdout)

        self.assertNotIn('2024-01-01', single.stdout)
        flat = self.run_cli('list', '--no_grouping')
        self.assertIn('2024-01-01 09:00', flat.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('\t', flat.stdout)

        rounded = plain(self.run_cli('list', '--round', '15m', '-d', '2024-01-02').stdout)
        self.assertIn('00:00   00:15', rounded)
        self.assertIn('15m', rounded)

        self.assertIn('1970-01-01', zero.stdout)

    def test_check_warnings_and_preservation(self):
        self.put('  # note  \n2024-01-01 09:00 | P | D\n\nnot an activity\n')
        result = self.run_cli('check')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, 'Found 3 line(s) with parsing errors\n\n# note\n  -> could not parse activity (Line: 1)\n\n\n  -> could not parse activity (Line: 3)\n\nnot an activity\n  -> could not parse activity (Line: 4)\n')
        result = self.run_cli('last')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.count('Warning: Ignoring line'), 3)
        result = self.run_cli('change')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, '')
        self.assertTrue(self.log.read_text().startswith('# note\n'))

    def test_search_and_recent_deduplication(self):
        self.put('2024-01-01 09:00 - 2024-01-01 10:00 | P | Alpha\n'
                 '2024-01-01 10:00 - 2024-01-01 11:00 | Q | Beta\n'
                 '2024-01-01 11:00 - 2024-01-01 12:00 | P | Alpha\n')
        text = plain(self.run_cli('last').stdout)
        self.assertIn('[1] Beta', text)
        self.assertIn('[0] Alpha', text)
        self.assertEqual(text.count('Alpha'), 1)
        self.assertIn('[0] Alpha', plain(self.run_cli('search', 'ALPHA').stdout))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('search').stdout, 'No matching activities found\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('projects', '-n').stdout, 'P\nQ\n')

    def test_sanity(self):
        self.put('2024-01-01 09:00 - 2024-01-01 12:00 | P | First\n'
                 '2024-01-01 10:00 - 2024-01-01 09:00 | P | Second\n')
        result = self.run_cli('sanity')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, 'Activity has negative duration\nActivity started before another activity ended\nSecond (Started: 2024-01-01 10:00, Ended: 2024-01-01 09:00, Line: 2)\n\n')

    def test_second_precision_and_extended_years(self):
        self.put('2024-01-01 09:00:29 - 2024-01-01 09:00:30 | P | D\n')
        result = self.run_cli('list')
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr.count('WARNING:'), 2)
        self.assertIn('09:00   09:01', plain(result.stdout))
        self.put('-0001-01-01 09:00 - -0001-01-01 10:00 | P | D\n')
        self.assertIn('-0001-01-01\t1h 00m', self.run_cli('list').stdout)

    def test_missing_files_and_environment(self):
        self.log.unlink()
        result = self.run_cli('list')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn('Could not read from file:', result.stderr)
        result = self.run_cli('start', '-d', 'D', '-p', 'P', '-t', '09:00')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.env['BARTIB_FILE'] = str(self.log)
        result = self.run_cli('projects', use_log=False)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, '"P"\n')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('list', '--round', '15m', '-d', '2024-01-01').stdout, 'No activity to display\n')
        rounded = plain(self.run_cli('list', '--round', '15m', '-d', '2024-01-02').stdout)
        self.assertIn('00:00   00:15', rounded)
        self.assertIn('15m', rounded)
        zero = self.run_cli('list', '--round', '0m')
        self.assertIn('1970-01-01', zero.stdout)

    def test_check_warnings_and_preservation(self):
        self.put('  # note  \n2024-01-01 09:00 | P | D\n\nnot an activity\n')
        result = self.run_cli('check')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, 'Found 3 line(s) with parsing errors\n\n# note\n  -> could not parse activity (Line: 1)\n\n\n  -> could not parse activity (Line: 3)\n\nnot an activity\n  -> could not parse activity (Line: 4)\n')
        result = self.run_cli('last')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.count('Warning: Ignoring line'), 3)
        result = self.run_cli('change')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, '')
        self.assertTrue(self.log.read_text().startswith('# note\n'))

    def test_search_and_recent_deduplication(self):
        self.put('2024-01-01 09:00 - 2024-01-01 10:00 | P | Alpha\n'
                 '2024-01-01 10:00 - 2024-01-01 11:00 | Q | Beta\n'
                 '2024-01-01 11:00 - 2024-01-01 12:00 | P | Alpha\n')
        text = plain(self.run_cli('last').stdout)
        self.assertIn('[1] Beta', text)
        self.assertIn('[0] Alpha', text)
        self.assertEqual(text.count('Alpha'), 1)
        self.assertIn('[0] Alpha', plain(self.run_cli('search', 'ALPHA').stdout))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('search').stdout, 'No matching activities found\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.run_cli('projects', '-n').stdout, 'P\nQ\n')

    def test_sanity(self):
        self.put('2024-01-01 09:00 - 2024-01-01 12:00 | P | First\n'
                 '2024-01-01 10:00 - 2024-01-01 09:00 | P | Second\n')
        result = self.run_cli('sanity')
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, 'Activity has negative duration\nActivity started before another activity ended\nSecond (Started: 2024-01-01 10:00, Ended: 2024-01-01 09:00, Line: 2)\n\n')

    def test_second_precision_and_extended_years(self):
        self.put('2024-01-01 09:00:29 - 2024-01-01 09:00:30 | P | D\n')
        result = self.run_cli('list')
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr.count('WARNING:'), 2)
        self.assertIn('09:00   09:01', plain(result.stdout))
        self.put('-0001-01-01 09:00 - -0001-01-01 10:00 | P | D\n')
        self.assertIn('-0001-01-01\t1h 00m', self.run_cli('list').stdout)

    def test_missing_files_and_environment(self):
        self.log.unlink()
        result = self.run_cli('list')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn('Could not read from file:', result.stderr)
        result = self.run_cli('start', '-d', 'D', '-p', 'P', '-t', '09:00')
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.env['BARTIB_FILE'] = str(self.log)
        result = self.run_cli('projects', use_log=False)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, '"P"\n')
